disposition_reason: The paper includes an ordered model fit for trials-to-learn across reward intervals, but numeric author-model RSS/AIC baselines, original animal inclusion and exact source mapping are not recovered. The existing 60/600-second numerical reconstruction covers a smaller endpoint set; a new animal-held-out comparison would be an extension, not the original model comparison.

source_paper.title: Duration between rewards controls the rate of behavioral and dopaminergic learning

evidence.supports: All-five-ITI model fitting, averaging simulation iterations, log-RSS selection followed by AIC, TDRL censoring and penalty variants.
Summed squared log-space residuals with missing-observation handling.
Raw-scale MSE-based AIC formula with nAnimals and parameter penalty.
Five-ITI NWB selection, learner filtering, 37-second windows/7-second baseline and twenty simulation iterations per ITI.
Correction addresses misalignment of the top-row rasters in Fig. 4b; it does not itself supply a model baseline.

target.description: Model number of trials until conditioned responding across ITIs 30, 60, 300, 600 and 3,600 seconds. This source model endpoint is one part of the paper’s behavior/dopamine learning claims.

dataset.description: Author Figure 5 selects five-condition experimental NWB observations and simulation summaries; exact immutable DANDI release and behavior-summary manifest remain to bind.

cohort.description: Original learning-analysis animals and source learner filtering must be recovered for all five ITIs; the local 38-mouse 60/600-second component is not the full comparison.

split.description: The recovered original fit uses all five experimental ITIs with models_to_exclude=0, fitting and comparing the same observations. It is not animal-held-out generalization; any new holdout is an extension.

inputs.description: Original reward/cue schedules, animal learning summaries and the declared model simulation procedures. Source cached summaries are reconstruction outputs, not candidate prediction inputs.

preprocessing.description: Source Figure 5 uses learner selection and 37-second windows with seven-second baseline; behavior_fit averages simulation iterations and censors TDRL predictions using source trial caps [800,400,88,48,16]. Complete learning-threshold, animal and source-summary mapping must be authenticated.

metric.description: Selection RSS sums (log observed trials-to-learn − log mean predicted trials-to-learn)^2, omitting NaNs and assigning infinite loss to missing predictions. Reported AIC instead uses nAnimals×log(raw-scale mean squared error)+2k. These are different ordered metrics; the main source comparison uses k=0 with alternative penalties also calculated.

aggregation.description: Source RSS/AIC aggregate experimental animal observations across the five ITIs against model predictions averaged over simulation iterations. Simulation seeds/iterations are not biological replicates.

comparison.primary_metric: Original raw-scale AIC model comparison, with log-space RSS selection reported separately

published_baseline.description: Numeric published/source-author ANCCR AIC and RSS results have not been recovered; null is intentional. No local reconstruction tolerance or biological P value substitutes for them.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author behavior_fit/calculate_rss/calculate_aic give a source-author replay route; it has not been executed or authenticated for the full original comparison.

minimum_effect.rationale: A task-specific practically meaningful effect has not been justified; source reproduction tolerances and reported SEM are not improvement margins.

uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse, preserving its complete schedule and repeated measurements; simulation iterations are model variability only.
uncertainty.rationale: The original fit is in-sample across all ITIs. A valid predeclared improvement claim must account for fitted parameter selection and animal dependence without converting a new holdout into a same-task score.

paper_win_requires: Recover and reproduce the numeric original ANCCR/comparator score vector, complete animal roster and all five ITI conditions.
Preserve original in-sample fit/selection procedure, missingness/censoring and the correct AIC penalty convention; do not conflate log-RSS selection with raw-scale AIC.

Freeze the entire registered behavior/dopamine scope or explicitly limit any result claim to the recovered original model endpoint; the 60/600-second subset alone cannot satisfy full-paper superiority.
Predeclare a scientifically meaningful model-fit improvement, uncertainty rule and equal concrete access/compute budgets before final scoring.
Label an animal-held-out or new-schedule result as an extension with a separately rerun author comparator.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source-paper reproduction and source-author reruns are separate claims.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until numeric baseline and source inclusion are recovered. Development may inspect authorized model-fitting feedback only under a frozen original-task contract.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model family, parameter-selection procedure, simulation protocol, input census, metric penalties and full original score support before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay author and candidate using identical original observations and model-selection allowance; report AIC and log-RSS separately, plus declared behavior/dopamine scope.
episode.baseline_policy: Original author model score is the baseline. Numerical source reconstruction, a locally authored model and an animal-held-out rerun are separately labelled outcomes.

blocking_issues: Original numeric model AIC/RSS and source-selected hyperparameters remain unrecovered.
Immutable full five-ITI animal/data and learning-summary mapping are unresolved.
No complete same-task evaluator, justified minimum effect, dependence-aware uncertainty or concrete episode budgets exist.
Existing numerical scorer covers a 60/600-second component, not the full five-ITI model-comparison and dopamine programme.

legacy.notes: Retain registered-runtime source-compatible eghk reconstruction and its 38-mouse/309-session cue-roster evidence as calibration. Its numerical errors and coverage do not demonstrate source-model improvement.
